summary: RB Global, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing early termination of the HSR waiting period by the U.S. FTC for its pending acquisition of BigIron Auction Company. Financial terms were not disclosed in the filing. The termination satisfies one condition to closing, which is expected in Q2 2026, subject to other customary conditions. This marks a regulatory clearance milestone. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The deal is a straightforward acquisition progressing through the regulatory process. Watch for any remaining closing conditions and potential integration updates.
